svg.text: Four routes for structure into MuLAN
① Late concat of a WT-3Di block, between the embedder and Light Attention · encoder: ProstT5
3Di half — one string, all four rows
3Di is computed from backbone coordinates. For a point mutant those coordinates do not exist: SKEMPI ships one solved structure per complex, the wild type.
Every variant of a complex has to share one structure, because
only one was ever determined. So the 3Di half of the input is
constant across the pair before training even begins — for any encoder.
The obvious way out — model the mutant structure and recompute
its 3Di — is tab Ciii. It is a structurally guaranteed no-op.
